title: RuntimeExploreExplorePlan
description: Input plan for mod-runtime-explore. Secrets are by reference only (env-var name or gitignored file path), never inline.

base_url.description: The running app's base URL the crawl starts from.

url_scope.description: Allow/deny globs checked before EVERY navigation (the containment guard). Deny wins.

auth.description: EXACTLY ONE shape: flat single-realm (creds_from + creds_ref, no profiles) OR profiles (named realms, each with its own creds — no top-level creds). login_url is always required (the shared default; a profile may override).

creds_ref.description: An env-var NAME (creds_from: env) or a gitignored file PATH (creds_from: file). Never the secret itself.

profiles.description: Named login realms for multi-realm apps that share one login URL but differ by input selectors. Names + selectors are arbitrary and operator-supplied.

submit_selector.description: Optional; falls back to a generic submit.

login_url.description: Optional per-profile override of the top-level login_url.

creds_ref.description: An env-var NAME or gitignored file PATH — never the secret itself.

seed_data_ref.description: Path to a gitignored file of realistic form values by field name/role.

roles.description: Named user-role perspectives (#1563). Empty ⇒ single-perspective run (byte-identical). Non-empty ⇒ a FULL separate crawl per role, merged + role-tagged. Requires an auth block.

login_profiles.description: Ordered auth.profiles keys to log in through. Empty ⇒ use the flat single-realm login. More than one ⇒ CHAINED login (authenticate through each realm in order). Each named key must exist under auth.profiles.

creds_ref.description: The role's OWN credential reference: an env-var NAME or gitignored file PATH — never the secret itself. The profile supplies selectors; the role supplies credentials.
